title: Face-filter demonstration

location.series: Pentagram / Natural History Museum case study
location.extent: Published video poster and complete associated clip

slide_intent: Let people participate in an identity, because a brand can become something an audience performs rather than only observes.
strategic_value: Letter rings that appear around faces can turn the Museum’s mark into a playful participatory effect.
demonstration: Three portrait videos take turns becoming brighter while colored letter rings grow around open mouths; the other two portraits remain dimmed.
practical_value: Compare a shared effect across different faces and examine how focus moves between examples.

content_islands.name: Portrait triptych
content_islands.spec: Align three vertical portrait panels on a pale ground.

content_islands.name: Active example
content_islands.spec: Brighten one portrait at a time as the circular letters appear around the mouth.

content_islands.name: Shared effect
content_islands.spec: Vary the ring color while retaining its radial structure.
